problem: After Stage5A_R2 repaired the challenge_39_9 selector + reconciled the affected record, the owner's real-device retest still showed LOCKED. Root cause: the challenge ENTRY flow (pages/challenge-start → startChallenge cloud function) unconditionally created a NEW trial record on every tap and its hasAccess only consulted `memberships` — it never honored the paid challenge_39_9 record unlock (challenge_records.trialMode===false / unlocked===true written by the payment finalizer). Evidence: the payer openid holds 26 challenge records, 24 still trialMode:true at currentEventIndex=3, including TWO fresh trial records created during the retest (08:22:25, 08:23:53) — the flow minted new locked records instead of resuming the unlocked one. getChallengeEvent reads only trialMode, so the reconciled record itself is fine; the entry flow discarded it.

changes.SERVER_RESUME_AUTHORITY: cloudfunctions/startChallenge/index.js: for non-diagnostic mode, BEFORE creating a record, query challenge_records for an existing UNLOCKED record owned by the trusted OPENID — where {openid, mode:'challenge', trialMode:false} (fallback: {openid, mode:'challenge', unlocked:true}), newest first — and if found and not finished, RETURN that recordId (resumed:true, trialMode:false) instead of creating a new trial. Server-authoritative: never trusts a client claim; ownership on wxContext.OPENID; cross-user isolation preserved. If no unlocked record exists, behavior unchanged (normal trial creation); membership (challenge_unlock) access still yields trialMode:false.
changes.NO_CLIENT_CHANGE: No client code change required — challenge-start calls the shared startChallenge cloud function, so deploying the function fixes the preview build in place.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/challenge-resume-authority.test.js (R1–R8, 12 assertions): resumes on trialMode:false; resumes on unlocked:true only; creates trial when none unlocked; prefers unlocked over newer trial; does NOT resume finished; membership legacy path preserved; cross-openid isolation; diagnostic mode unaffected.
